body:
1. Garden level 2: you can buy it only at gardening level 20.
2. Garden level 3: only at gardening level 40.
3. Each garden level adds 3 new beds at the back, open as soon as you buy it. They work like today's beds. New save spots after 35, so old saves keep working.
4. Garden levels also give more space and nicer looks (the Non-living chat designs them).
5. Pots keep Izabele's rule (idea 75): 6 open at each gardening level 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, in today's spots.
6. A pot appears only when it opens.
7. Pet yard level 2: only at Pet care level 20. Level 3: only at Pet care level 40.
8. Training gear: small gear for each pet fits at pet yard level 1; the agility course needs level 2.

comments.text:

short: Garden levels: +3 beds each; pet yard 20/40 Pet care; pots unchanged

title: Garden and pet yard levels need skill
